records.text: Operation Valhalla Strike took place August 24th-29th, 2024, where the 891st Squadron from Minot Air Force Base traveled to Camp Ripley Training Center in Minnesota for training focused on air-based ground defense and nuclear security tactics, including full-distance live-fire exercises.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

verification.notes: Dates are wrong: Operation Valhalla Strike took place Aug 24-29, 2025 (not 2024 as claimed). All other details confirmed: 891st Squadron from Minot AFB trained at Camp Ripley in Minnesota for air base ground defense and nuclear security tactics with full-distance live-fire exercises.
